label: Triage Assistant
focus: Use for any request to classify, rate or answer yes/no about a short text (category, urgency score, is-it-X); delegate it here instead of answering yourself. Answers typed questions about a short text (at most 4000 characters) with a local model. The question MUST be JSON, never plain prose. Send the question as JSON: {"text": "...", "questions": {"id": {"type": "choice|score|noul", "instructions": "...", "criteria": ...}}}. choice criteria = {option: description}; score criteria = ordered list of level descriptions, lowest first; noul (yes/no) criteria optional {"false": "...", "true": "..."}. Returns JSON with an answer, answer_confidence and an uncertain flag per question; treat uncertain answers as provisional. Does not generate text, fetch data or call tools.
